rationale: A pluggable exporter class implementing the Exporter interface that converts the model into GraphML for external visualization tools. It is a named, replaceable unit used by the export command and the MCP export manager. It starts telemetry spans itself. It returns a string rather than writing to disk.

A small lookup that wraps getValidRelationships to return cardinality and strength for a catalog triple. It is a minor internal function of the relationship command module. It has some catalog meaning, but sits near helper granularity and implements none of the cross-cutting concerns.

In-code data structure that carries changeset diff results (additions, modifications, deletions) between the virtual projection and preview/diff display. It is neither persisted nor published as a schema, so it is an application DataObject. It is a notable internal type that a maintainer explaining the module would name.

Private string-sanitizing helper that replaces path traversal and invalid filename characters before its callers save files. It is a trivial formatting utility and an implementation detail with no standalone architectural meaning. It performs no I/O itself.

Nested recursive helper inside computeDirectoryHashes that walks a directory and hashes files. It is an implementation detail of the hashing utility, not a named architectural element. It reads files from disk, so data_persistence applies; its console.error is incidental and does not amount to an observability concern.

Bundled JSON Schema document that defines the testing layer's node types (contextvariation, coverageexclusion, etc.) as Draft-07 schemas with $id URNs. It is a core schema contract the CLI validates models against, not a test asset, so it belongs to data-model as a schema document.

A passive TypeScript interface that carries backup record state (the list of files and a timestamp). It has no behaviour of its own and is not published as a schema, so it is an application data object. It is a minor type, and the code that reads or writes backups to disk lives elsewhere.

CopilotClient is a concrete chat-client adapter, extending BaseChatClient, that spawns the external GitHub Copilot CLI as a subprocess and streams its responses. That makes it an integration-point application component. It instruments its own calls with telemetry spans and logs messages, so observability is also set.

Static configuration module defining per-layer relationship templates (an interface plus a constant table) used by the audit gap-analysis feature. It holds data only, with no behaviour, so it is a data object. A maintainer would name it when explaining the audit analysis module, but it is not a service or boundary.

A small exported TypeScript interface that carries validation status counts within the stats collector. It is a passive in-code data structure, not persisted or published as a schema, so it is an application data object. It has no callers recorded and is of minor significance.

Internal mapping helper that normalizes a raw CBM graph node into a route record with defaults. Its only caller is verify(), and it was extracted solely for testability. It is a data-shaping detail of the CbmAnalyzer component, not an element a maintainer would model on its own.

GapAnalyzer is a class that the audit orchestrator composes. It analyses layer templates to find missing relationship candidates and assigns them priority and impact scores. It is a cohesive internal analysis unit in the audit subsystem, which a maintainer would name when explaining that module, but it is not a system boundary. It performs no I/O.

A trivial terminal-colour formatting getter that wraps ansis bold green and is conditional on colour support. It is a formatting utility below the modelling granularity, with no callers and no architectural role, so it is not recorded as an element.

A utility module providing SHA256 file hashing helpers for change detection. It is a generic implementation detail supporting integration installation rather than a named architectural element. It reads files from disk, so it touches persistence, but it sits below modelling granularity.

An in-memory BFS traversal method on the GraphModel class. It is internal graph-query behaviour of the core model component, delegated to by Model.traverse. It is a minor unit, below the level of a named service. It does no I/O, security, telemetry or UI work.

Core class loading the predicate catalog and relationship schemas from bundled JSON files on disk and exposing relationship type definitions. It is used by the audit orchestrators, the CLI commands and the report model. It is a central, reusable application component that reads durable storage files.

A small internal TypeScript interface describing the shape of compiled spec data inside the spec loader. It has no callers and no behaviour, so it is a type-shape implementation detail rather than a named architectural data object.
